description:
I was reincarnated into a reverse harem romance fantasy novel. Into the story’s worst villainess, Evgenia, who ruthlessly torments her cousin, the female protagonist, and, despite being married, stalks one of the male leads, the crown prince!  

H.ow.ever!  

The villainess’s husband was my ultimate favorite.  
As for the female and male protagonists, I didn’t care; I just planned to live happily ever after with my favorite.  
But then……  

"Please divorce me, wife."  

My husband said this absurd thing, his voice trembling with emotion.  

Seeing his eyes glistening with tears naturally made my heart go soft.  

Alright, if it’s for my favorite.  If what you want is a divorce from me...

"No, I won’t. Go back."  

Whatever else happens, I can never allow a divorce!  I tore up the divorce papers in the face of Euclid.
